simple.meaning: זֶה (zeh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 5:1. The surrounding context includes family line, righteousness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זֶה (H2088) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: זֶה (zeh) / H2088 is traced through Genesis 5:1, Genesis 5:29, Genesis 6:15, Genesis 7:1 with generated occurrence evidence.

for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown so great before Yahweh that Yahweh has sent us to destroy it.”
